description:
**SALE AGREED**

Welcome to 28 Clover Hill on the Dooradoyle Road, brought to you through Auctioneers in Limerick, Rowan Fitzgerald.

This is a fantastic 4 bed semi detached home with 2 ensuites, gas heating and with an efficient BER of C2.
As you enter no. 28, viewers will appreciate a generous sized hallway which leads through to a very comfortable living room with bay window and a solid fuel fireplace at its centre. Toward the rear of the home there is a well equipped kitchen with ample cupboard space, there is also a very useful and convenient utility room. Off the kitchen interested parties will find the dining room with sliding doors that open out onto the South West Facing rear garden. Moreover, a spacious ensuite double bedroom is located on the ground floor, together with built in wardrobes. There is also a guest WC located on the ground floor under the stairs.

Moving upstairs now where there are 3 further bedrooms and the master bathroom. The main double bedroom is spacious and also benefits from a good sized ensuite. Likewise, Bedroom no. 2 is a very good size, with more than enough space for a double bed and overlooks the rear garden. Bedroom no. 3 is a single room and similarly looks out over the garden. It is worth noting that all 4 bedrooms in the property do greatly benefit from built in wardrobes, furthermore the Master Bedroom and Bedroom no. 2 have the advantage of built-in vanity tables. The Master Bathroom is fully tiled and is well appointed.

The South West Facing Rear Garden is safe for young children and has secure side access.
This home is situated on an elevated plot within the development.

This home is ideally located within walking distance to many very convenient amenities:
The Crescent Shopping Centre
Crescent Comp Secondary School
Gymnasium
Raheen Ind. Est.
UL Hospital
Also, it is very worth noting that access to the Motorway network is a mere 2 minute drive.

Block Built c. 1999, Tiles on Hipped Roof
Gas Heating
BER C2
Approx. 122 Sq Mt/1313 Sq Ft
Double Glazed Windows
Stira Stairs to attic
Previous Rent Reg. at : €860 PCM
Off Street Parking

Inviting offers of €399,000+

To arrange a viewing on this great property, call Limerick Auctioneers Rowan Fitzgerald on 061 279423
